visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with short brown hair, wearing a white wide-collared blouse over a beige vest, is seated at a wooden table in a brightly lit restaurant. She is focused on a pink bag on her lap, searching through it with both hands. In the background, other patrons are seated at tables, and a wooden partition is visible. (2) She looks up directly at the camera with an inquisitive expression, then returns to searching her bag and picks up a blue denim jacket beside her, shaking it slightly. Her mouth is moving as if asking a question. Behind her, a group of women are dining and talking in a moderately lit indoor environment. (3) The woman realizes her mistake, smiles broadly, and laughs, covering her mouth with her right hand in an embarrassed gesture. Her eyes squint in amusement, and her head tilts slightly. The camera remains focused on her as she continues to chuckle, looking down at her bag and then back up at the camera. (4) She looks at the camera, continuing to laugh while gesturing with her hands. She points a finger at the viewer while speaking. The setting remains the interior of the restaurant with warm lighting and wooden furniture. Her expression is energetic and joyful as she continues to react to the person filming.
